inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: A person with an inactive background was observed with access to children. The person was asked to leave during the inspection by the person in charge.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: There were 2 groups of children observed transitioning into the snack room and the caregivers were observed to have walked in first while there were still children walking behind the caregivers.In another incident a caregiver was observed to have stepped out of her classroom to watch children put away their belongings on a shelf, that was in a separate classroom, there was only the 1 caregiver present to supervise both groups of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know how many children responsible for: There were 2 classrooms that were unaware of the number of children in their group. In one group a caregiver stated she had 15 and it was determined she had 14. In another group a caregiver stated she had 6 children and it was determined she had 7 children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know how many children responsible for (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A person with a pending background check was observed having access to the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedure for Parents Review of Policies: The operation has not provided the corrections to the Operational Policy that are required: parent rights, procedures for inclusive care, employee vaccinations, emergency preparedness, procedures for parents to participate and immunization requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedure for Parents Review of Policies (26 TAC §744.501(18))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedure for Parents Review of Policies: The operational policy did not have a section for the following: parent rights, procedures for inclusive care, employee vaccinations, emergency preparedness, procedures for parents to participate and immunization requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedure for Parents Review of Policies (26 TAC §744.501(18))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A person with a pending background check was observed caring for a group of children.   The person was sent home during the inspection by the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Plan-Emergency plan for diagnosed child, signed by health care professional and parent: There were 2 children with documented food allergies and there were no food allergy plans on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Plan-Emergency plan for diagnosed child, signed by health care professional and parent (26 TAC §744.2669)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Plan-Emergency plan for diagnosed child, signed by health care professional and parent: There was one child in care with food allergy and the child did not have a food allergy plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Plan-Emergency plan for diagnosed child, signed by health care professional and parent (26 TAC §744.2669)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: There was one person with a pending background check that was observed supervising a group of children.  The person was sent home during the inspection, bringing the deficiency into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: There were 4 persons, that had a "pending"  background check, observed supervising a group of children. The persons were sent home during the inspection and other staff was brought in to maintain ratio and group sizes.
